field_principles.arm_configs: Names the Rust/PyO3 and exact Python fallback SamplerBackend configurations under one contract.
field_principles.build_profile: Freezes release/debug, PyO3 ABI, and feature settings before timing.
field_principles.cpu_affinity: Shows the CPU set used for timing instead of leaving scheduler placement implicit.
field_principles.end_to_end_times: Preserves the primary timing evidence that includes all production overhead.
field_principles.excluded_pair_reasons: Keeps failed or unmatched pairs in the denominator instead of silently shrinking evidence.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why every crossover field exists before a reviewer trusts the JSON shape.
field_principles.fpga_or_tsu_used: Bare false records that no FPGA, board, or TSU participated.
field_principles.gpu_speedup_claimed: Bare false prevents the retired CPU/CUDA substrate from being reopened.
field_principles.hardware_receipt: Authenticates CPU, OS, memory, affinity, and observable frequency without implying board or accelerator use.
field_principles.hardware_speedup_claimed: Bare false prevents Rust/PyO3 CPU timing from becoming a board or TSU claim.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Starts complete: or blocked: and states whether the Rust/Python crossover is proven or terminal null.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares matched CPU Python versus Rust/PyO3 production SamplerBackend sampling, not LLM, GPU, or hardware timing.
field_principles.kernel_times: Reports the measured SamplerBackend sampling call cost separately from setup and validation.
field_principles.matched_work_receipts: Proves transitions, energy evaluations, replicas, swaps, restarts, checkpoints, stopping, and initial states are identical.
field_principles.measured_repetition_count: Proves each qualified size/family has at least thirty timing repetitions.
field_principles.paired_speedup_intervals: Uses bootstrap intervals so a crossover cannot rest on one noisy repetition.
field_principles.paired_speedup_ratios: Reports paired Python/Rust end-to-end ratios rather than unrelated aggregate means.
field_principles.peak_rss_by_arm: Records memory pressure by arm so speed is not traded against unreported RSS growth.
field_principles.preregistered_protocol: Freezes workloads, sizes, seeds, repetitions, warmups, budgets, margins, thresholds, and null rules before timing.
field_principles.problem_sizes: Makes the PyO3-overhead to kernel-dominated size range explicit.
field_principles.pyo3_overhead_times: Records PyO3 boundary probe cost without subtracting it from primary end-to-end timing.
field_principles.qualified_crossover_n: Records the first gated consecutive crossover size or null for a terminal no-crossover result.
field_principles.quality_margins: Predeclares feasibility, energy, acceptance, swap, target, restart, and work-counter margins.
field_principles.quality_matched_pair_count: Counts only pairs that passed quality gates before timing intervals.
field_principles.quality_metrics_by_pair: Reports quality before any speedup denominator is formed.
field_principles.random_seeds: Records the ten paired seeds and benchmark-order seed for replay.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content-addresses the complete artifact after blanking the self-checksum field.
field_principles.rust_crossover_ready_score: Equals 1.0 only when matched quality and end-to-end timing prove a Rust CPU crossover with no hardware claim.
field_principles.serialization_times: Reports checkpoint/JSON serialization cost separately while keeping it in end-to-end timing.
field_principles.software_receipt: Records Python, NumPy, Rust extension, compiler, and source hashes needed to replay the production arms.
field_principles.software_speedup_claimed: Bare boolean separates an allowed Rust/Python software timing claim from a null result.
field_principles.thread_receipts: Records thread environment and observed thread pools so Python and Rust work are compared under the same CPU policy.
field_principles.timing_claimed: Bare true declares this is a CPU timing study, unlike Exp5714/5715/5723 parity-only artifacts.
field_principles.topology_families: Shows all hardness/topology families entering the denominator.
field_principles.upstream_gate_receipts: Pins Exp5611/5623 CPU/CUDA terminal scope and Exp5714/5715/5723 one-axis Rust/Python readiness before timing is interpreted.
field_principles.validation_times: Reports per-run validation cost separately while keeping it in end-to-end timing.
field_principles.warmup_count: Prevents cold-start effects from entering primary measurements.
field_principles.workload_manifest: Lists every size/family Hamiltonian and descriptor hash used by both arms.
